svg.title: 04 · ApplyPilot
svg.desc: ApplyPilot (Web app): Finds jobs, scores them against your verified resume, and applies only with your approval. Built with React, TypeScript, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, n8n, Playwright, Gemini API. Not public.
